name: UK National Curriculum — Key Stage 3
description: The statutory National Curriculum for England, Key Stage 3 (Years 7–9). Sets out the programmes of study and attainment targets for each subject. Schools must teach the required content but have flexibility in how they organise and deliver it.
assessmentNote: KS3 does not have national standardised tests. Assessment is at teacher and school discretion. Students progress to GCSE (KS4) at Year 10.
